name: Minor Healing Draught
flavor: Tastes like copper and regret. Works anyway.

name: Greater Healing Draught
flavor: The good stuff. Don't ask what's floating in it.

name: Battle Tonic
flavor: Bottled adrenaline. Legal in most jurisdictions.

name: Iron Skin Elixir
flavor: Your skin doesn't turn to iron. It just feels like it does.

name: Healing Tonic
flavor: Charcoal and droppings. It works, somehow. Don't ask.

name: Smelly Bomb
flavor: The smell alone lowers its guard.

name: Painkiller Colada
flavor: Coconut cream, pineapple juice, and just enough dark rum to make the wounds feel like someone else's problem.

name: Zombie's Revenge
flavor: Five rums, one grudge, zero survivors. Hits harder than it should. So do you, right up until you trip over your own feet.

name: Blue Hawaiian Haze
flavor: Blue curacao and rum, served with a little umbrella that does absolutely nothing. Somehow, neither do incoming attacks.

name: A bag of mystery powder
flavor: You saw some goblin's eating this candy with their noses... how strange...

name: Succo Di Ratto
flavor: Juice of the rat.

name: Complimentary Mint
flavor: He hands these out at the door, one per guest. You've taken several more than one.

name: Bar of Suds
flavor: Scrubs the grime clean off. Also, apparently, curses.

name: Steeped Towel Compress
flavor: Still warm. Still a little damp. Somehow that helps.

name: Hot Spring Salts
flavor: Steep your feet. Steep your soul.

name: Gnomish "Poppers"
flavor: One sharp inhale and the room gets a little brighter, a little slower, a little louder. It doesn't last long. Nothing about tonight was meant to.

name: Leather Daddy's Protein Shake
flavor: Tastes like protein and poor decisions.

name: GNAM Broth
flavor: He made soup. Out of something. It's the best full heal in the delve.

name: The Last Birthday Slice
flavor: Somebody's name is still piped on it in grease, and nobody's come to claim it in thirty years. Somehow that makes you feel emboldened after eating it.  Weirdo.

name: Stale Candy
flavor: This candy is older than you are.  It's chewy like taffy, even though you are pretty sure it wasn't like that originally.  Still, it leaves you feeling perkier.

name: Now Illegal Energy Drink
flavor: The caffiene content of this drink has been outlawed for decades now.  Mmm... Crystaly.

name: Cheese Pizza
flavor: The simplest thing the oven makes, and it fixes a little bit of everything.

name: Pepperoni Pizza
flavor: The pepperoni has a little kick, and so do you.

name: Extra Greasy
flavor: You're so slick that nothing can get a grip on you, including your fork.

name: Deep Dish
flavor: It sits in your stomach like a brick, and now you're as hard to move as one.

name: Hawaiian
flavor: Nobody wants to be caught eating it, so you finish it fast and keep moving.

name: Diavolo
flavor: Too hot to eat, so you throw it. It burns right through whatever they're wearing.

name: Garlic White
flavor: Garlic keeps away whatever's got hold of you.

name: The Supreme
flavor: It has a little of everything, so it does a little of everything.
